units.function: Client-side UX preflight that estimates inline JSON import size, identifies content-addressed blob entries, offers a blob-dropping fallback and formats byte estimates.
units.dependencyDirection: A UI-only helper depends on the shared portability file-entry type. It does not call the server or own transport policy, but hard-codes an assumed server body limit and package-path convention.
units.keyDataModels: Record<string, CompanyPortabilityFileEntry>, fixed inline byte/envelope limits and InlineImportPreflight estimatedBytes/tooLarge/canDropAttachments.
units.lifecycle: Estimate serialized path and entry bytes; compare against 56 MiB; re-estimate after removing matching blob paths; return display-oriented flags.
units.testAssessment: Focused Vitest passed 9/9 tests in one file on 2026-08-19. Tests correctly cover UTF-8, JSON escaping, path-key bytes, envelope overhead, base64 structure, thresholds and stripping, but not server-limit negotiation, malicious path normalization, huge entry counts or non-file request fields.
units.designRationale: Prevent a browser from constructing an oversized inline request and offer a lower-fidelity attachment-free path before directing large imports to ZIP upload.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs responsive client guidance for managed-cloud and self-hosted limits, while the API remains the canonical enforcer and data/evidence loss requires explicit informed approval.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the UTF-8/JSON-aware estimation technique in the independent Company OS Web, but obtain negotiated transport limits/capabilities from the deployment profile, return stable loss codes and never treat the client result as a security boundary.
units.responsibilityConflict: The UI labels removal of every blobs/** entry as dropping attachments, although blobs may also back embedded evidence/images. It provides no enumerated loss manifest, accountable-human confirmation or reviewed-plan digest after content removal.
evidence: 916c13501f80c7d1d659b89e4a06dc47366aa80f Replace host-to-host Cloud Sync with full-fidelity company Import/Export (#10507)
5ca752dc81cfb01f74282e1b562694079e1d0cf1 fix(server): raise company import zip upload limit to 1 GB and make it operator-configurable (#11184)
securityFindings: The 56 MiB limit is hard-coded while the server ZIP/body cap is operator-configurable; capability drift can produce false allow/deny UX.
A fixed 256 KiB envelope can undercount very large rootPath, selection, overrides, secret-input maps or other request fields not present in files.
Blob-path matching accepts any prefix ending in blobs/<one-segment> and runs before canonical path validation.
stripBlobFiles removes all blob-backed content, including possible embedded evidence, while canDropAttachments understates the data-loss scope.
Client estimation cannot replace server streaming limits, decoded-byte/count quotas and digest verification.
